label: Badge
description: A small status/count indicator overlaid on another element (e.g. a notification count on an icon).
useWhen: Showing an unread count or a short status label attached to another element.
The information is a quick-glance supplement, not the primary content.
avoidWhen: The count or status is critical information the user must not miss — use a Tag or Alert instead.
The label needs to wrap to multiple lines — badges are for very short content only.
do: Keep badge content to a number or 1-2 characters.
Position the badge consistently relative to its anchor element.
dont: Use a badge as an interactive control — it is a label, not a button.
Stack more than one badge on the same element.
accessibility: Provide the full context via aria-label on the anchor element (e.g. "Notifications, 3 unread") — the badge's visual text alone is not sufficient for screen readers.

props.name: count
props.description: The number or short label shown inside the badge.
